about: [C4] The click test (docs/story/briefs/C4_FIGHT.md §3): him standing in the diner with his guard down, doing nothing; each mouse button pressed 30 times at each of 60, 120, 200 and 280 ms by real input, shuffled, 0.12 .. 0.55 s apart. Every press must start a jab in its step and reach its contact within 0.08 s; none may turn into a wind-up. node tools/play.mjs tools/plays/fight_click.json

steps.check: D.sent === 240 && D.pressed === 240 && D.jabs === 240 && D.contacts === 240 && D.late === 0 && D.max <= 0.08 && D.clickWinds === 0 && D.winds <= D.stretched.length && D.air === 0
steps.label: [C4] 240 clicks of 60 to 280 ms, both buttons: a jab on every press, its contact within 0.08 s, never a wind-up from a click (a press the loaded machine stretched past 0.3 s may load, and is counted apart)
